verdict.rationale: An auth framework exposing HTTP endpoints could reasonably ship a machine-readable API spec, so this axis applies. However, the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404, and no doc in the pack describes an OpenAPI or equivalent spec. llms.txt and the docs MCP server are documentation resources, not API specs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
